fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: This material is a review article and does not present original large-scale microbiome association data or specific sample sizes to verify the evidence insufficiency mentioned in the gap question. This study systematically analyzes the incidence, pathophysiological mechanisms, diagnostic criteria, and prognosis of major cardiovascular toxicities linked to ICIs in the context of microbiome interplay.
